system.description:
A full suit of heavy mail: 4D armor on every location (+1D on the torso), including a matching helmet (Open-faced Bascinet). Clumsy weight: Agility +2 Ob, Climbing +1 Ob, Health/Forte for fatigue +1 Ob, Throwing and Shooting +2 Ob, Stealthy +1 Ob, Swimming +2 Ob, Speed -1D, Perception/Observation +1 Ob (helmet). Without Armor Training: +1 Ob to all tests.

Poor quality: all 1s rolled count for losing armor dice. Costs half the run of the mill price (rounded up).

Armor test: roll the location’s armor dice vs Ob 1 + the weapon’s VA; meet the obstacle and the blow is warded off. The torso (breastplate) always gets +1D. Shields may be included in an armor kit at no extra cost. Pieces may be bought separately: a helmet or breastplate costs half the full suit; arms (greaves) or leggings a third (round up).

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 474
